chunks: But only disavowed and turned away;
ai.seo_question: What was the reaction of the disbelievers to the Prophet's message in Surah Al-Qiyamah?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Mursalat, this verse encapsulates the dual response of the Meccan polytheists: active denial (kadhdhaba) and willful avoidance (tawalla), reflecting their spiritual blindness. Shia exegesis often links this to the concept of *Jahiliyyah* (pre-Islamic ignorance) where rejection stems from pride rather than lack of evidence. This serves as a paradigm for the consequences of ignoring the Ahl al-Bayt's guidance when it is presented with clarity.
